snippet.title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2027 Announcement Trailer | Multiplayer Demo Out Now!
snippet.description:
Mutliplayer Demo Out Now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2692660/Car_Mechanic_Simulator_2027/

Build, repair, and grow your automotive empire — now also in co-op mode! Run a workshop together, fix cars, and expand your collection. Hundreds of configurations, thousands of parts, and full customization await!
